description: The Reward Bonus is issued in the dollar unit, with a raw value of 2,500 fractional units. This amount corresponds to a base‑unit value of $25.00, since there are 100 cents in a dollar. The currency symbol displayed both in the rendering locale and in the native locale is “$”, and the ISO 4217 code for the currency is USD (numeric code 840). In English it is called the US Dollar, and the localized display name is likewise “US Dollar”. The fractional unit of the currency is the Cent, and the conversion rate is 100 cents to one dollar.
